latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly turn text prompts into downloadable 1080p videos with visuals and music.

- Upload TXT, DOCX, PDF, or MP4 (up to 200MB); describe your video; get a ready-to-post MP4 in ~1-2 minutes.
- Automated setup: quick connect via anonymous token (no account needed).
- Cloud pipeline: all editing/rendering happens server-side; no software or camera required.
- Easily check credits, job status, or export results by text command.
- Robust error handling with clear guidance for common issues (like missing credits or file size limits).
